scope: Public package integrity, retained numerical inputs and isolated-environment figure/table reproduction.

numerical_integrity.comparison_scope: This cleanup compared all retained CSV rows, scientific configurations, notebook computations and workbook contents against the immediately preceding public package.

inputs.ci_definition: pointwise normal 95% CI of Monte Carlo mean; fixed training seed16
limitations: Appendix config audit covers selected initialization dependencies; notebook adds baseline historical-code checks
Baseline marginal coverage is separately checked by paper_analysis.coverage; joint coverage is outside current scope
PPT model schematic is externally maintained; calibration rerender is not old PDF byte replica
Travel unmet retains manuscript accepted two-decimal source precision

coverage.reference_source: training_sampler: logged R4 validation-state sample, 16384 per interval
coverage.query_source: E3 periodic virtual query states, 10000 per fine interval
coverage.aggregation: query-count-weighted recorded marginal fractions over 1100 intervals
coverage.limits: Empirical marginal coverage only; not joint coverage or coverage of the unknown true optimum. Quantiles are not mean CIs.

trajectory.reconstruction: a=diff(Z)+native demand+HF referrals-local unmet; Q=142-cumulative total a
trajectory.demand: calibrated native weekly means; HF excludes referrals; Warehouse uses system sum
trajectory.bands: pointwise empirical path quantiles, not confidence intervals
trajectory.q_display: clip negative roundoff to zero; retain raw values in path_quantiles.csv

limitations: Reproduction uses saved simulation results. Full training and pretrained reevaluation were not performed.
Original CHA observations and model weights are not included.
Two schematic diagrams are static references.
MIT covers code and software documentation; no separate data license is assigned.
